camera.placementNote: Held in right hand, close to body.

setting.lighting: dim, warm ambient light from front/left, likely a bedside lamp
setting.colorPalette: dark, warm tones, black, white, beige

garments: black crewneck t-shirt with small graphic on left chest

pacing.rhythm: rapid-fire cuts, one question per clip, fast pacing

audio.syncNotes: cuts occur immediately before and after each spoken line

lines.text: Questions to ask pilots in the flight deck during a potty break.
You ever see any aliens out there?
Is this your first time flying an airplane?
Is flying an airplane like driving a car?
Do you prefer Pipers or Cessnas?
So, are you married or happily married?
How many girlfriends do you have?
It's like, not that hard to be a pilot, right?
Can I have forty thousand dollars?
Am I your favorite flight attendant you've had so far?

whyItWorks.mechanism: Taboo/inappropriate questions delivered with a completely deadpan, serious expression creates comedic contrast.
retentionDrivers: rapid pacing of cuts keeps attention high
whyItWorks.targetViewer: flight attendants, aviation enthusiasts, people who enjoy dry, sarcastic humor
whyItWorks.shareCommentTrigger: tagging coworkers or commenting on the accuracy of the stereotypes

mustKeep: looking off-camera to simulate a conversation partner
swappable: profession being mocked (e.g., 'questions to ask doctors')
